_about: TEMPESTA GT3: its race display on the column is modelled as a screen's glass (glass_GLASS) over a blank face: the glass gets a panel with a race cluster of its own: the revs in a band across the top, the speed, the gear, the clock and the lap time, the lamps. The steering wheel's grip (a piece of the cabin's material the model's cut left in the body) is moved onto the wheel so it turns with it (wheel_parts: the pieces within its disc, 17 cm round its axis, 4.5 cm either side of its plane). Box: metres from the steering wheel's centre (the model's axes: x right, y up, z back).
